no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for an Advisory Committee meeting as no clinical efficacy or safety issues arose that required an Advisory Committee meeting and discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for Defitelio (defibrotide, NDA208114). The FDA review documents (SumR, CrossR, ODMemo, and MedR) uniformly state the application was not referred for an Advisory Committee meeting because it raised no controversial clinical efficacy or safety issues and no significant public health questions requiring outside expertise. As no AdComm was held, there were no committee-driven changes to the approval.
